integrity: General proof given with complete hypotheses; finite exhaustive verification for small dimensions and independent binary subset enumeration. No claim of independent validation or of novelty proven by search absence.
scientific_limitations: Applies to cyclic length-three incidence posets for n at least five, over named parameters; not generalized to all hyperedge lengths. Prior general extension characterizations and Pell--Lucas traces are acknowledged. A published equivalent restricted census is possible despite comparisons.
title: Silver-ratio one-point type spectrum and linear two-sided cuts of cyclic triple-incidence posets
